extras: v2.0.0 introduced a breaking change, switching encryption from RSA 4096 to ML-KEM-768, invalidating all old keys and encrypted data.
intentEvidence: Obsync Webdav PQC Sync gives you the convenience of WebDAV and self-hosted storage with the privacy of end-to-end post-quantum encryption.
problem: Standard cloud sync solutions lack end-to-end encryption, allowing providers to read vault data, and existing sync methods are vulnerable to future quantum computing attacks.
summary: Post-Quantum encryption and WebDAV sync plugin that encrypt vault data and filenames using ML-KEM-768 for end-to-end security.
